title: localconfig.vdf whose last line is '}}': python-vdf only looks at the first character of a line, so it parses; the port rejects the file (currentLaunchOptions null, launch profile 'default')
severity: wrong response (currentLaunchOptions/activeLaunchProfile) and, for launch-options, the port refuses to edit a file python-vdf edits
culprit: steam/vdf.rs parse (token based, stricter than the line-oriented python-vdf)
suggested_fix: port python-vdf's line algorithm literally: lstrip each line; skip empty and '/'-lines; line[0]=='{' skips the whole line; line[0]=='}' pops one level and ignores the rest of the line; else match the key/value regex (unquoted keys/values, quoted values continuing over lines, `[cond]` handled by the value regex); errors only at EOF / extra '}' / missing '{'
